paras: The Eventuri Carbon Intake for the BMW G80 M3 / G82 M4 is now officially released, including the new CSL model. Being the most ambitious and technically advanced intake to date. This intake has been over 1 year in development, as Eventuri pushed the boundaries of design and technology to bring something truly groundbreaking to the industry. Eventuri is the first company to redesign the entire G80 system, including the turbo inlets which are the biggest restriction on the stock intake. Eventuri has carried out intensive R&D to develop an intake that not only improves on the stock M3/M4 but also is future proof in its capacity to cater for high-powered builds well in excess of 1000hp. Eventuri maximised the usage of the available space to employ 2 custom made filters with a 40% larger filtration area than stock. These are used in the Patented Venturi housings to smoothly funnel the air to the turbo inlets.
